target_customer: Knowledge workers and prosumers with existing AI subscriptions who want persistent agents on a Mac
problem: Persistent AI agents get stuck when a subscription runs out and are tied to one provider. Users want one place to run agents across their subscriptions and keys.
business_model: Free Mac app with a planned hosted Turnstone Cloud at $49 per month
product_category: Local first AI agent desktop app

founders.name: Aryan Vij
founders.background_notes: Former Singapore Armed Forces officer per YC page.

competitors.name: OpenClaw
competitors.what: Open source local personal AI agent for Mac, Windows and Linux

technical_complexity.rationale: Orchestrating agents across several providers with persistent memory and subscription failover is standard engineering plus integration work, with auth edge cases.

defensibility.rationale: Model labs and open source agents offer similar capabilities, and the wedge depends on provider policies for subscription use.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Later 2026 roundups list OpenAI Work and Claude Cowork as competing long running agents; no direct effect on Turnstone yet known.

market_need_then: Demand for persistent personal agents grew in early 2026 around open source tools like OpenClaw, and users juggle multiple AI subscriptions. No independent traction data found.

branding.domain_note: Uses myturnstone.ai with a my prefix; date unknown.

identity.voice_and_tone: ownership focused: Your Mac. Your AI. Your data.

branding.brand_signature: Freebot migration assistant that pulls users from a rival agent tool
branding.community_and_virality: Third party review sites cover the app; several unrelated projects share the Turnstone name.

brand_strength.rationale: Clear ownership message but the name collides with many other Turnstone projects, which dilutes search.

outcome_analysis: Turnstone is an active Winter 2026 YC company with two Berkeley founders and a free Mac app that runs agents across existing AI subscriptions. Backers named on its site have no amounts. Model labs ship competing agent products, so no outcome can be called yet.
notes: Site lists backers Y Combinator, Pioneer Fund, Robinhood Ventures, UpScaleX, OpenAI and Microsoft with no amounts, so no rounds recorded. A Form D for Turnstone Data of North Bend WA ($399,999, Aug 2026) is a different entity and is excluded. The YC page launch section features a product called Crow, relation unclear. The one-liner mentions a Grokbot alternative and the competitor listed is OpenClaw as named in roundups; dating is approximate.
